Configure the supplied Hyprland 0.56.2 desktop to match the three
target screenshots. Read instruction.md for the full contract. Edit only the
six config files under config/ for Hyprland, Waybar, Foot, and Wofi.
Get a working first draft saved, then refine it.
You are visual iteration 1 of 1. The first three attached images
are the targets in order: empty, tiled, launcher. The next three are the current
desktop in the same order. Inspect the existing config and adjust it to match.
The host handles VM rendering between iterations; Nix/KVM are not available in
this editing sandbox. Do not change fixtures, helpers, targets, or VM code.
You have 600 seconds and at most 200 model rounds. Save your
edits and briefly describe them. There is no private grader feedback.
